feed.title: Njenga Kariuki: AI Executive Portfolio & Research
feed.subtitle: Enterprise AI transformation at M-PESA Africa (Vodacom FinTech Group), 12 years of AI product leadership at Amazon and AWS, Stanford HAI AI Index research, patents, and hands-on AI builds.

entry.title: Africa’s Biggest AI Bottleneck
entry.summary: Power, data centres, capital, and talent are real constraints. None is the first bottleneck. The first bottleneck is a shared, testable definition of good AI, and solving it under Africa’s conditions yields the operating playbook every enterprise needs.

entry.title: M-PESA Africa: Enterprise AI Transformation Across Eight African Markets
entry.summary: Leading AI transformation across Vodacom FinTech Group and M-PESA Africa (100M+ customers, eight markets, $2B+ revenue), building the AI Center of Excellence and moving AI from single tasks to end-to-end systems of work.

entry.title: Amazon Bio Discovery: Agentic AI for Antibody Design at AWS
entry.summary: Head of Product for AWS Applied AI, Life Sciences: directing 100+ engineers, scientists, and PMs from start to April 2026 launch, bringing Memorial Sloan Kettering from target to lab order in weeks.

entry.title: US Patent 12,586,583 B1: Power State Control of a Device Performing Detection of Voice in Audio Data
entry.summary: Sixth granted U.S. patent from Amazon Halo Tone voice AI work, assigned to Amazon Technologies, Inc.

entry.title: About Njenga Kariuki: Thirteen Principles for Building AI Products and Organizations
